peopleAlsoAsk.question: What is the method we use when inoculating a plate with culture?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: There are two methods for inoculating (putting the bacteria on) agar plates: quadrant streaking and spread plating. Which one you choose depends on what you want to do after. The quadrant streaking technique is used to isolate single colonies of one or more types of bacteria or fungi.
